name: Tyria
title: Executor
description: A hard-to-please girl from Monastir. She normally maintains a proud and elegant manner of speech, but when pushed past her limit, her words can turn surprisingly harsh and vulgar.
introduction:
A hard-to-please girl from Monastir.

She normally maintains a proud and elegant manner of speech, but when pushed past her limit, her words can turn surprisingly harsh and vulgar.

Gifted with natural taste and refinement, she treasures time spent enjoying high culture, from art and music to theater.

For her, nothing makes a day more perfect than following a routine filled entirely with her own tastes.
